registration.design: Each lane: independent open/hold RSI, 100 real prefix substeps, 1/3/5/10 x 20ms perturbed learned feedback then return to unperturbed feedback. Total jaw width additions Uniform[0,14] mm; arm vector random direction, norm Uniform[0,25] mrad, every fourth lane zero arm or zero jaw. Validity stops after first hard terminal. All attempts retained; no case references.

substep_state_check: historical challenge stored per-substep forces and complete successor; no substep pose file
modes: first interval: physical finger loads and commanded reference phase; recontact uses branch-local contact history
predictor: open-loop propagation with measured clipped commands; comparison uses identical windows and successors
nonfinite: count per predictor, metric, side, horizon and mode; large finite errors retained in maximum
